# Choosing where to host

## Two options

We compared hosting the wiki ourselves with paying for a managed service. Self-hosting costs less each month and keeps the data on our own servers, but it needs an engineer to apply updates and take backups. The managed service costs more, whereas it includes backups, updates and support, and it can be ready today. Self-hosting would take about two weeks to set up.

## Decision

The team will decide at the next planning meeting.
